title: South China Sea trade, 1681-1792
authors: Prof.dr  J.L Blussé van Oud-Alblas, Universiteit Leiden
contributors: drs J. Oosterhoff, Erasmus Universiteit Rotterdam, prof.dr L.J. Blussé van Oud-Alblas, Universiteit leiden (primary investigator)
descriptions: The dataset provides facts and figures about the trade between Batavia and China, by way of the South China Sea, in the period 1681-1792. It provides quantitative and qualitative information about ships and trading products. The dataset is the result of a project carried out at the Institute for the History of European Expansion (IGEER), Leiden University.
